name: purple
shortdesc: purple-mri: ex vivo MRI DL segmentation, surfaces and parcellation
longdesc: Run the combined purple-mri adult ex vivo DL and surface workflow. Assign the main MRI to exactly one hemisphere tag: InputMRI_LH for left or InputMRI_RH for right. Outputs include segmentation layers and optional FreeSurfer attachments.
